fields.label: Name
fields.description: For example a site, a building or a use such as Vehicle Yard.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Used by every warehouse that has no WMS Settings of its own or on a parent. A warehouse picks its settings on its WMS Settings field; its child warehouses follow it unless they pick their own.

fields.label: Enforce Block on Weight Limits
fields.description: When off, levels set to Block only warn (alarm mode), so no posting is ever refused for weight.

fields.label: Weight Alarm At (%)
fields.description: Warn when a posting fills a level to this share of its weight limit. 0 = warn only above the limit.

fields.label: Default Put-away Source
fields.description: Where received stock waits before it is put away. The scan screen starts from here.

fields.label: Email Customer on Short Pick
fields.description: When a pick finishes short, email the Sales Order contact what ships now and what is back-ordered.

fields.label: Hold Minutes
fields.description: How long a Stock Hold (e.g. a web cart) keeps stock before it lapses.

fields.label: Label Width (mm)
fields.description: Page size of the WMS Location Label and WMS Tote Label print formats (one label per page).

fields.label: Location Labels
fields.description: What each location role is called in Warehouse 3D, for example Area, Pillar, Bay and Level for a vehicle yard. Blank keeps the role name. Only the displayed name changes; the stored role does not.

fields.label: Slot Colour
fields.options:
Fullest Level
Share of Levels Used
fields.description: Fullest Level: a slot takes the colour of its fullest level (racks). Share of Levels Used: amber while any level is free, red only when all are full (stacks of single items, such as vehicles).

fields.label: Warehouse Fields to Show
fields.description: Fieldnames of Warehouse, one per line, shown for the selected level and its slot in the side panel (for example fields added by another app).

fields.label: Serial No Fields to Show
fields.description: Fieldnames of Serial No, one per line, shown with each serial number on a level (for example a registration number).
